subject: Got NA in Model test baseline model when using MLR

messages.author: d15762527144a2ff
messages.subject: Got NA in Model test baseline model when using MLR
parts:
Dear all,

I was using R to run growth curve analysis. However, when I used MLR, I got NA in Model test baseline model.

Here is my code. The version of lavann is 0.6-1.1215 

library(lavaan)
library(semTools)
library(mice)
library(devtools)
ECLS <- read.csv("eclskdata.csv", header=T)
summary(ECLS)
model1r <- '
# intercept and slope
# with fixed coefficients
  i=~ 1*readfk+1*readsk+1*readff+1*readsf
  s=~0*readfk+1*readsk+2*readff+3*readsf
'
fit1r <- growth(model1r, data = ECLS,estimator="mlr",missing="FIML")
summary(fit1r, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

Here is the output


Can anyone help me solve this problem?
Thanks.

Best,

Sky
